comment: tty_nhgetch() reads one byte per input boundary, and the recorder writes each moves character as UTF-8. The 3-byte '€' (E2 82 AC) is read as M-b, M-^B and M-, at three successive boundaries; the 2-byte 'ä' and 'ð' (C3 ..) each open #conduct (M-C) and their second byte is ignored by the conduct window. The recorder keeps moves.length + 1 boundaries, so the game reads the last four bytes after its last kept one; they make no RNG call.
